objective: Independent e2e validation of WI-1 against 16 acceptance criteria; emit APPROVED | FAILED | CONDITIONAL verdict with evidence.

defects.title: fact_experiment_result 6 PDF-mandated metrics NULL across all 12 synthetic cells; v_pareto_frontier collapses to 0 rows

evidence.query: SELECT method, noise, rmse_m, seg_f1, seg_precision, seg_recall, coverage_ratio, boundary_err_s FROM fact_experiment_result WHERE source='synthetic'
evidence.observed: 12 rows; every one of the six metric columns is NULL
evidence.expected_per_AC-10: 0 rows match (source='synthetic' AND any of six metrics IS NULL)

defects.root_cause: Two-fold regression. (1) data/bronze/synthetic parquet was generated 2026-11-09 17:02 - pre-T-002 - and does not carry __truth_id, so run_experiment.py:223 truth-from-bronze fallback never activates. (2) reconstruct_from_silver (run_experiment.py:177) gates the six metrics behind 'if source == synthetic and truth is not None and not truth.empty'; the NoiseTruth sidecar built by prepare_silver is correctly passed through the ProcessPool but the guard excludes it from reaching the scorers. New runs 43..54 therefore write only continuity/n_flights/n_deviations to eval_results, and because stage_eval_mart picks latest run per (source,noise,method) the prior fully-populated runs 35..40 are shadowed.
defects.suggested_fix: Preferred: relax run_experiment.py:177 so NoiseTruth sidecar alone suffices (NoiseTruth.original_coords + original_ids is the authoritative truth for synthetic). Interim: regenerate data/bronze/synthetic with post-T-002 etl4/ingest/synthetic.py so __truth_id flows through and the existing wrapper fallback kicks in.

defects.title: T-002 __truth_id round-trip test still auto-skips because skipif probe targets make_flight (which never emits the column) instead of generate_synthetic (which does)

evidence.repl_check: make_flight has __truth_id: False; generate_synthetic has __truth_id: True; monotonic_increasing: True; is_unique: True

defects.root_cause: Probe function signature mismatch. The feature IS live at runtime; the skipif predicate is wrong.
defects.suggested_fix: Point _synthetic_emits_truth_id and the test body at generate_synthetic (or synthetic.main's output DataFrame); drop the skipif.
